import scipy.ndimage as ndi


def clean_mask_3d(mask, radius=2):
    mask = np.asarray(mask)
    st = ndi.generate_binary_structure(3, 1)
    st = ndi.iterate_structure(st, radius)
    m = ndi.binary_opening(mask.astype(bool), structure=st)
    m = ndi.binary_closing(m, structure=st, iterations=5)
    m = ndi.binary_dilation(m, structure=st, iterations=2)
    m = ndi.binary_fill_holes(m)
    lab, n = ndi.label(m, structure=ndi.generate_binary_structure(3, 1))
    if n:
        m = lab == (np.bincount(lab.ravel())[1:].argmax() + 1)
    return torch.tensor(m, dtype=bool)

from tqdm import tqdm

with (
    h5py.File("/home/zimmer08/datacheck/data/ds000221_t1w.h5", "w") as ft1w,
    h5py.File("/home/zimmer08/datacheck/data/ds000221_t1map.h5", "w") as ft1map,
    h5py.File("/home/zimmer08/datacheck/data/ds000221_mprage.h5", "w") as fmprage,
):
    for subject in tqdm(
        list(Path("/home/zimmer08/datacheck/data/ds000221").glob("sub*"))
    ):
        try:
            mprage1 = load(subject.rglob("*inv-1_mp2*.nii.gz")).permute(2, 1, 0).flip(1)
            mprage2 = load(subject.rglob("*inv-2_mp2*.nii.gz")).permute(2, 1, 0).flip(1)

            t1w = load(subject.rglob("*T1w*.nii.gz")).permute(2, 1, 0).flip(1)
            t1map = load(subject.rglob("*T1map*.nii.gz")).permute(2, 1, 0).flip(1)
        except StopIteration:
            print(list(subject.rglob("*.nii.gz")))
            continue

        mask = (mprage1 + mprage2) > 40
        mask = clean_mask_3d(mask)
        t1w = (t1w / t1w.max()) * mask.float()
        t1map = (t1map / 1000) * mask.float()
        mprage1 -= mprage1.min()
        mprage1 /= mprage1.max()
        mprage2 -= mprage2.min()
        mprage2 /= mprage2.max()
        mprage1 = mprage1 * mask.float()
        mprage2 = mprage2 * mask.float()
        ft1w.create_dataset(
            subject.stem,
            data=t1w.float()[70:220],
            compression="lzf",
            shuffle=True,
            chunks=(1, *t1w.shape[1:]),
        )
        ft1map.create_dataset(
            subject.stem, data=t1map.float()[70:220], compression="lzf", shuffle=True, chunks=(1, *t1map.shape[1:])
        )
        fmprage.create_dataset(
            subject.stem + "_1",
            data=mprage1.float()[70:220],
            compression="lzf",
            shuffle=True,
            chunks=(1, *mprage1.shape[1:])
        )
        fmprage.create_dataset(
            subject.stem + "_2",
            data=mprage2.float()[70:220],
            compression="lzf",
            shuffle=True,
            chunks=(1, *mprage2.shape[1:])
        )

import scipy.ndimage as ndi


def clean_mask_3d(mask, radius=2):
    mask = np.asarray(mask)
    st = ndi.generate_binary_structure(3, 1)
    st = ndi.iterate_structure(st, radius)
    m = ndi.binary_opening(mask.astype(bool), structure=st)
    m = ndi.binary_closing(m, structure=st, iterations=5)
    m = ndi.binary_dilation(m, structure=st, iterations=3)
    m = np.array([ndi.binary_fill_holes(s) for s in m])
    lab, n = ndi.label(m, structure=ndi.generate_binary_structure(3, 1))
    if n:
        m = lab == (np.bincount(lab.ravel())[1:].argmax() + 1)
    return torch.tensor(m, dtype=bool)
